audit.source: read-only source audit frozen into explicit pytest node lists; no runtime glob or -k discovery

layers.H0: Host/frontend/IR structural checks; no numeric or device-success claim.
layers.H1: Lowering/code generation/device compilation without a numeric hard gate.
layers.G: GDN compilation/launch smoke only; success is G_SMOKE, never correctness.
layers.P: Reference-checked numerical parity; every collected case must execute and pass.

explicit-cuda-target.note: Target is pinned by the test; no host-arch substitution.

dependency_policy.note: Probe only. Never install FA/FLA, downgrade torch, or treat one package as a substitute for the other. requirements-test-cuda.txt pins flash-attn==2.5.8 with torch<2.14; a torch>=2.14 environment is diagnosed, not modified.

operator_groups.notes: Compilation smoke only: no reference assertion; a pass is G_SMOKE, never PASS_NUMERIC.

z3_opt_in.purpose: Dedicated annotated-loop compile fixture; ordinary pytest nodes are not opted in.
